thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — Arkfield (enterprise) experiencing increased connection errors to /v1/embeddings (us-west-2). Severity: P1. Paging oncall.
sanjay: I'm on it. Seeing lots of TCP RSTs from gw01->model-pool: connection reset spikes ~09:12 UTC.
maya: Confirmed from Arkfield support: 30% of embedding calls failing, some timeouts at ~5s. They reported onboarding jobs failing.
lia: Are we seeing errors only in us-west-2 or global? quick grep of logs shows similar but lower rate in us-east.
sanjay: Primary impact us-west. Autoscaler churn looks normal. No obvious OOMs. Rolling restart of gw01 decreased RSTs briefly.
oliver: Can we get an immediate customer-facing note? Arkfield is high-touch — need tailored impact and contact routing. I'll draft.
caroline: On Arkfield side: contacts — CTO: emma@arkfield.com; Infra lead: devin@arkfield.com; CSM: laura@arkfield.com. They want live updates every 15m.
status-engineer: Draft status page update: "Investigating — We are aware of elevated connection failures affecting embeddings in us-west-2. Some enterprise jobs may experience failed requests or timeouts. Engineers are actively mitigating; next update in 15 minutes." ok to post?
support-bot: Scheduled incident channel updates every 15m. Auto-attach logs from gw01 and connection metrics.
maya: Customer notif draft (please edit): "Arkfield team — We are investigating intermittent connection failures impacting embedding requests in us-west-2. Impact: Retryable 5xx and connection resets causing failed jobs for a subset of requests. Mitigation: engineering is restarting affected gateway nodes and routing traffic to healthy pools. ETA for stable routing: ~30–45 minutes. Contact: laura@arkfield.com for account questions; please reply if you need higher touch."
oliver: Shorten ETA to 30m and add workaround: "If possible, please retry with a linear backoff. For bulk jobs, pause and resume after 30m." Add link to status page.
sanjay: Mitigation steps executed: rolled gw01 -> gw01-2, disabled problematic AZ routing. Failures down from 30% -> 8% on earliest metrics. Continuing soak and traffic shift.
lia: I'll take oncall for next 40m. @sanjay handing off. lia -> posting next status update at 09:30 UTC.
sanjay: Handoff acknowledged. I also kicked a fallback rule to prefer model-pool-b for Arkfield routes while we validate.
oliver: Customer note final (send now): "We have rerouted Arkfield traffic to a healthy pool and restarted affected gateway nodes. Some jobs may still see transient failures; we expect degraded errors to subside within 30 minutes. For urgent issues contact laura@arkfield.com or reply here and we'll escalate." Approve?
caroline: Approve. I'll send from AM account and include the 15m cadence.
status-engineer: Posting status: /status update "Investigating — Elevated connection failures affecting embeddings (us-west-2). Mitigation in progress; next update 09:30 UTC." Posted.
support-bot: Slack thread to Arkfield CSM created and message queued to email list.
lia: Monitoring dashboards show latency stable; error rate trending down. Will post final update when error rate <1% for 10 minutes.
maya: Internal postmortem note: collect gw01 socket stats, gateway restart timeline, routing decision logs, and Arkfield request traces for the window 09:05–09:25 UTC.
oliver: After-action comms template (internal): "Summary: Arkfield experienced connection resets to embeddings in us-west-2 causing ~30% failures. Root cause: transient gateway socket exhaustion in gw01 (investigating kernel limits / upstream spiky retries). Mitigation: restarted gateway node, temporarily shifted routing to model-pool-b, applied fallback rule. Customer impact: some bulk jobs failed; most recovered after routing shift. Next steps: increase ephemeral socket pools, add backoff in gateway, and run canary for routing changes." Use for postmortem.
lia: 09:28 UTC — errors at 0.9% over last 10m. Posting final customer update and closing page incident if stable for another 15m.
support-bot: Final update queued to Arkfield contacts and status page. Incident channel will remain open for 1h for monitoring.
caroline: Thanks team. I'll send a summary to Arkfield CSM inbox and schedule a follow-up call if they request it.:thumbsup:
